# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `newt` MCP server from `reiwa-travel/newt-mcp-server`, pointing at NEWT's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.newt.net/mcp`). No auth.
- Logo: Reiwa Travel mark from the `reiwa-travel` GitHub organization avatar (256×256).
